answer: Because the timing is published against the jade challenge, the dawn audit can replay the summit history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 110 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1131 identities would post 1056 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
